Solution

The Solution

PatientPath is a secure, centralized digital platform for medical document sharing.

High-level concept

  • Providers can upload and share documents instantly through a secure web system
  • Patients have limited access to view their information
  • The goal is improved continuity of care, accuracy, and efficiency
